integrity: Analytic proof provided; finite exact combinatorial checks and stochastic diagnostics are corroborative only. Bibliographic priority not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Classifies signs and gives an absolutely convergent positive circuit-partition series for complete products of once-centered spherical geodesic lengths; it does not determine all mixed distance moments or their entire joint law. The graph moment pairing machinery and the three-point case have substantial prior literature. Historical priority for the all-graph conclusion remains provisional, especially against general tensor-network formulations and incompletely accessible early random-spherical-triangle work.
title: Eulerian sign law for centered geodesic-angle products on round spheres
